entry.title: Christmas Lights Are Going Up in Downtown Roseburg
entry.summary: Christmas lights are going up on around 50 trees in downtown Roseburg. City Councilor Zackary Weiss said the crew has about 4,000 feet of lights and hopes to decorate part of Main Street if time allows.

entry.title: Douglas County Sheriff’s Office Mourns Retired K9 Eros
entry.summary: Eros, a retired Douglas County Sheriff’s Office K9, died at 8½ years old. The German shepherd served nearly five years and was deployed more than 100 times before retiring in September to live with his handler, Deputy William Maynes, and his family.

entry.title: Roseburg Library to Screen Program on Nazi War Criminals Who Fled to South America
entry.summary: Roseburg Public Library will screen a free Smithsonian Associates program Dec. 10 about how Nazi war criminals escaped to South America after World War II and how investigators tracked some of them down.

entry.title: Santa Paws Returns to Festival of Lights Tuesday With Dog Walk and Photos
entry.summary: Santa Paws returns to the Umpqua Valley Festival of Lights on Tuesday, Nov. 24, with a dog walk through the lights, $5 photos with Santa, a bake sale and a raffle. Proceeds support animals in the care of Saving Grace Humane Society.

entry.title: Rain and Gusty Winds Tuesday in Roseburg, With a Wet Thanksgiving Ahead
entry.summary: Rain and wind gusts up to 26 mph are possible in Roseburg Tuesday. Wednesday is expected to stay dry through the day before Thanksgiving brings a 90% chance of rain and a high near 57.

entry.title: Oregon Delays Commercial Dungeness Crab Season Until at Least Dec. 16
entry.summary: Oregon has delayed its commercial ocean Dungeness crab season until at least Dec. 16 after rough seas held up preseason testing. The recreational ocean season is still scheduled to reopen Dec. 1.

entry.title: ODOT Warns of Possible I-5 Ramp Closures at Oakland, Delays on Highway 138E
entry.summary: ODOT says the southbound I-5 exit at Oakland may close overnight through November. Highway 138E remains down to one lane near Paris Reservoir, with additional work on Highway 38 near Scottsburg and Highway 42 near Winston and Green.

entry.title: Oregon Delays Enforcement of Medicaid Work Rules Through June 2027
entry.summary: Oregon will delay enforcement of new federal Medicaid work and activity rules through June 30, 2027, giving affected Oregon Health Plan members more time to show they meet the requirements or qualify for an exemption.

entry.title: Douglas County Senior Services Takes Part in Subaru’s Holiday Giving Campaign
entry.summary: Douglas County Senior Services is taking part in Subaru’s holiday giving campaign, which supports Meals on Wheels America. The county served more than 82,000 meals through its senior nutrition program in 2025–26.

entry.title: Oregon Board Proposes Health Coverage for All Residents Without Premiums or Deductibles
entry.summary: An Oregon board has proposed covering all state residents without health insurance premiums or deductibles. The plan would be funded primarily through an employer payroll tax and household contributions based on income. Lawmakers will consider the proposal.

entry.title: Oregon Sues SpaceX and X Over Sexualized Images Created by Grok
entry.summary: Oregon is suing SpaceX, X Corp. and two related companies, alleging they misled users about safeguards meant to prevent Grok from creating sexualized images of adults and children without their permission.

entry.title: Rain Likely in Roseburg on Thanksgiving After a Mild Wednesday
entry.summary: Roseburg could reach 60 degrees Wednesday before rain moves in late that night. Thanksgiving has a 90% chance of rain, with up to half an inch possible. A Coastal Flood Warning includes Reedsport from Tuesday morning through Thursday evening.

entry.title: Nature Writer Marina Richie to Speak at Roseburg Public Library Dec. 9
entry.summary: Nature writer Marina Richie will discuss her book Feathered Forest at 6 p.m. Wednesday, Dec. 9, at Roseburg Public Library. The free program will also feature wildlife biologist Janice Reed, who will discuss her research on spotted and barred owls.

entry.title: Umpqua Singers to Bring Jazz and ’60s R&B to UCC Concert Tuesday
entry.summary: The Umpqua Singers will perform jazz, 1960s R&B and popular favorites at 7 p.m. Tuesday, Nov. 24, at UCC’s Whipple Fine Arts Center. Tickets are $15 general admission and $10 for seniors at the door. Students get in free.
